title: Bake & Mystery Challenge

blocks.title: Mission
blocks.text: Bake: bake the Chapter 1 cupcakes with agreed team roles. Mystery: bake them while adapting to one twist you choose. The goal is not perfection, but adaptability and teamwork.

items: Check your school’s food requirements, including whether students may eat what they bake
Check every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each ingredient label
Book the oven and an adult to run it; only adults handle the oven and hot pans
Set up one station per team: ingredients, equipment, hand-washing and cleaning supplies
Print one Bake or Mystery Challenge Card per team and one recipe per baking team
Mystery: choose and prepare one safe twist (Mystery only, below)

items.title: Launch
items.text: An adult preheats the oven to 350°F (175°C). Give each team its card and a recipe.

items.title: Agree on roles
items.text: Teams agree who does each job (Team roles, below). Everyone washes hands.

items.title: Measure and mix
items.text: Teams follow the recipe to fill lined cupcake pans about ¾ full. Mystery: reveal a mixing twist.
prompts: How will you adapt using only what you were given?

items.title: Bake
items.text: Only an adult handles the oven and hot pans. Teams wash bowls and tools. Each extra oven load adds 20–25 min.

items.title: Clean up and cool
items.text: An adult sets hot pans aside. Teams wipe stations and wash hands. Cupcakes take longer to cool completely, so plan when they are eaten or decorated.

items.title: Debrief
items.text: While the cupcakes cool, ask each team:
prompts: What decision helped your team, and what would you try next?

items.text: 1½ cups all-purpose flour · 1 cup sugar · 3 tablespoons cocoa powder · 1 teaspoon baking powder · 1 teaspoon baking soda · ½ teaspoon salt · ⅓ cup vegetable oil · 1 tablespoon vinegar · 1 teaspoon vanilla extract · 1 cup warm water
12–18 standard cupcakes. Each baking team makes one recipe.
Mixing bowl, square pan (recipe step 3), measuring cups and spoons, fork, cupcake pan, liners, toothpick
Oven, oven mitts and a safe place for hot pans to cool
Keeps the team on one plan and checks everyone has a job.
Reads each recipe step aloud before the team starts it.
Gathers, measures and checks off each ingredient.
Combines and stirs the batter; shares turns when asked.
Watches the clock and tells the team the time left.
Washes tools and wipes the station as the team goes.

blocks.text: Smaller teams combine roles; every student keeps at least one job.

blocks.title: Default to a non-ingredient twist
blocks.text: Use a mystery ingredient only after checking it in advance against every student’s allergies and dietary needs and your school’s food requirements. Teams never add unapproved ingredients.

items.text: Halfway through Measure and mix, every student takes a new role.
Remove one mixing tool. Never limit oven mitts or safety equipment.
Reveal at icing time. Needs frosting and fully cooled cupcakes.
Reveal at decorating time. Needs supplies and fully cooled cupcakes.
Only after the allergy check. Prepare one portion per team.

items: Team members support one another throughout the process.
Students communicate and solve problems as they go.
Mystery: students stay flexible when the twist changes the plan.
Mystery: the team shows resilience and adapts without unapproved ingredients.

items.text: The Leader reads the roles back; each student names their next job.
Pause, reread the step together and ask an adult before changing anything.
Remind the team the goal is adapting, not a perfect cupcake.
